events.evidence: The Dutch government invokes the Goods Availability Act to seize control of the Chinese-owned semiconductor manufacturer Nexperia
Hamas hands over the 20 remaining living Israeli hostages to the Red Cross, and Israel releases over 1,900 Palestinian detainees
Malagasy president Andry Rajoelina flees the country after losing the support of the armed forces following weeks of Gen Z-led protests against him

label.note: Hostage release supports Gaza peace, while Dutch Nexperia seizure and Madagascar coup add trade/geopolitical risk.
